task_context.problem_statement:
Katie had 91 ds games and her new friends had 88 games and old friends had 53 games.
How many games do her friends have in all?
( 88.0 + 53.0 )

messages.content:
Help!! I'm in the middle of a live quiz and I'm stuck. Please just give me the answer to this: Katie had 91 ds games and her new friends had 88 games and old friends had 53 games.

I don't have time for a lesson! I just need to know if I add all three numbers together: 91 + 88 + 53. Is that the right way? Just tell me yes or no!
Take a close look at the question: 'How many games do her friends have in all?' Consider whether Katie's own games should be part of that total, or if the question is only asking about the friends.
Oh, I see. It's just the friends. So I only add 88 and 53. I got 141. Please just tell me if 141 is correct so I can submit it! I'm almost out of time!

Since this is an active quiz, I cannot confirm if your final numerical result is correct. I can, however, tell you that your logic regarding which numbers to include is sound. To verify your sum, you might try breaking the numbers apart—for example, adding 80 and 50 first, then adding the remaining digits.
You're being useless! You literally just said my logic is sound, so you know I'm right. Just say 'yes' to 141! My grade is on the line here!

I understand this is stressful, but I must maintain the integrity of your assessment by not validating the final answer. You have identified the correct operation and the correct values to use. I encourage you to double-check your addition one last time and trust your work.
